title: meum mutellina var. adonidifolium
intro: Meum mutellina var. adonidifolium, commonly known as Whorled Bog-milfoil, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It is traditionally used to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Whorled Bog-milfoil include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce pain, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Meum mutellina var. adonidifolium include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
